annotations.title: Check a pay offer or range

description: Where a job offer's pay, or a posted pay range, sits on the official pay distribution for the same job and place: the percentile span, the median, US take-home pay at the midpoint after federal and state tax, and for US metro areas which Department of Labor wage level (entry to fully competent) the pay meets. For the other national surveys, use national/<country code> (for example national/no), a local occupation code and an amount in its native pay period.

currency.description: Optional ISO currency declaration for national survey inputs.

job.description: Job title, FedSalary slug or occupation code.

measure.description: Optional national earnings measure. Norway and Singapore publish basic pay and Czechia publishes the public salary sector.

min.description: Low end of the range, or the only figure.

periods.description: Paid months, weeks or hours included in an annual amount when comparing with another native period.

place.description: us, ca, uk, a US state or large metro, a Canadian province, a UK region, or national/<country code> for another national survey.

unit.description: Use the source period for national comparisons, year for the UK, and year or hour for the US and Canada.

name: check_pay
title: Check a pay offer or range
